# The Good Life Abroad

> > A curated travel program designed for seniors, retirees, and empty nesters seeking immersive cultural experiences across European cities like Paris, Lisbon, Barcelona, Vienna, and Florence.

Founded by Andrew Motiwalla (Peace Corps, Discover Corps), The Good Life Abroad offers slow travel programs with accessible tourism, local immersion, and community connections. The platform provides city guides, senior-friendly tours, and expat living resources for travelers over 55-60.

## Key Topics

- Senior travel programs
- Cultural immersion experiences
- European city living
- Accessible tourism
- Expat relocation for retirees
- Slow travel methodology
- Paris, Lisbon, Barcelona, Vienna
- Over-60 travelers
- Local community integration
- Historic sites and cultural tours
- Comfortable-paced activities
- Empty nesters lifestyle
- International retirement
- Tuesday Lunch Club community
- Andrew Motiwalla programs

- [Senior Travelers' Experiences with The Good Life Abroad (Video)](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/videos/our-community-members-speak-openly-about-their-experience): Video testimonials: Florence senior travelers share community experiences
- [Top European Cities for Senior Expats - The Good Life Abroad](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/become-an-expat/best-european-cities-for-expats-a-seniors-guide): Best European cities for senior expats: Lisbon, Paris relocation guide

## Paris City Guides for Seniors

- [Trips for Seniors Over 60 in Paris: Discover the City at a Comfortable Pace](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/paris/trips-for-seniors-over-60-in-paris): Paris senior trips guide: Louvre, cuisine, comfortable-paced activities
- [A Senior's Guide to Enjoying Paris at Night](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/paris/enjoying-paris-at-night-a-seniors-guide-to-the-citys-vibrant-nightlife): Paris nightlife for seniors: Sainte-Chapelle, Opera Garnier, dining

## Central European Experiences

- [Vienna Senior Travel Guide: Immersive Experiences with The Good Life Abroad](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/vienna/vienna-senior-travel-guide): Vienna senior guide: Schönbrunn Palace, Klimt, accessible attractions
- [Inaugural Vienna Session with The Good Life Abroad | Live Like a Local](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/travel-adventure/viennas-debut-a-month-of-culture-connection-discovery): Vienna inaugural session: slow travel, Ringstrasse, local living experience
- [Exploring Prague Art Nouveau: A Retiree's Guide to Art & Architecture](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/prague/prague-art-nouveau): Prague Art Nouveau guide: Alfons Mucha, architecture for retirees 55+

## Spain & Portugal Destinations

- [Senior Travel Groups in Lisbon: Discover Portugal's Capital Comfortably](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/lisbon/senior-travel-groups-in-lisbon): Lisbon senior groups: Alfama, Jerónimos Monastery, accessible Portugal tours
- [A Senior's Guide to Savoring Barcelona](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/barcelona/savoring-barcelona-a-seniors-guide-to-dining-in-the-city): Barcelona dining guide: Catalan cuisine, accessible restaurants for seniors
- [Hidden Gems in Valencia for Senior Travelers: Explore the City's Best Kept Secrets](https://thegoodlifeabroad.com/city-guides/valencia/hidden-gems-valencia-senior-travel): Valencia hidden gems guide: Turia Gardens, local markets for seniors
